calculation_handling.description: In the R zone the maximum building depth is 17.0 metres for a detached house, semi-detached house, detached houseplex, semi-detached houseplex, townhouse or apartment building.

condition.if: lot_depth_m ≥ 36.0 m and lot_frontage_m < 10.0 m or lot_depth_m ≥ 40.0 m and lot_frontage_m ≥ 10.0 m

calculation_handling.description: Despite (A), a detached or semi-detached houseplex may have a building depth of 19.0 metres if the lot has a depth of 36.0 m or more and frontage under 10.0 m, or a depth of 40.0 m or more and frontage of 10.0 m or more.
calculation_handling.gaps: The condition has no parentheses in the grammar; it is read with 'and' binding tighter than 'or' ((i) or (ii)). Lot frontage here is the measured frontage.

condition.if: proposed_height_m ≤ 13.0 m and lot_depth_m ≥ 36.0 m and lot_frontage_m < 10.0 m or proposed_height_m ≤ 13.0 m and lot_depth_m ≥ 40.0 m and lot_frontage_m ≥ 10.0 m

calculation_handling.description: Despite (A), an apartment building 13.0 metres or less in height may have a building depth of 19.0 metres on a lot meeting the (i) or (ii) depth/frontage test, if no part of a side main wall with a primary window is set back less than 5.5 metres from a side lot line not abutting a street.
calculation_handling.gaps: The (iii) proviso (side main wall with a primary window at least 5.5 m from a non-street side lot line) is a design condition with no vocab token or DSL variable, so the 5.5 m is not expressed; 'and' binds tighter than 'or' in the condition.

units.disclosure: The 19.0 m depth for low apartment buildings also requires side walls with main windows to be at least 5.5 m from the side lot line; we do not check window placement.

calculation_handling.description: Despite (A) to (C), maximum building depth does not apply to a townhouse or apartment building on a lot abutting a major street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.10.40.30(1)(A) and (1)(C) for these types on major-street lots.

10.10.40.30(1).explanation: In the R zone a building may be at most 17.0 metres deep. Houseplexes, and apartment buildings up to 13.0 m tall with side windows well set back, may go to 19.0 m on deeper lots (36 m deep if under 10 m wide, or 40 m deep if 10 m or wider). Townhouses and apartments on a major street have no depth limit.
